culprit_citations.quoted_text: Non-controlled, non-affiliated investments, at fair value (amortized cost of $ 330,520,503 and $ 297,791,269 , respectively) | $ | 334,655,126 | $ | 300,732,065

findings.detail: The B01 population combines the March 31, 2025 schedule with the December 31, 2024 comparative schedule, producing 1006 leaves but only 495 current-period fair values.

rationale: B01 reports 495/1006 leaves with fair_value for the 2025-03-31 quarter. The filing source has a current March 31, 2025 investment fair-value anchor of 334,655,126 and a separate December 31, 2024 comparative anchor of 300,732,065. The current schedule closes at 334,655,126 in table 17, while the later comparative schedule closes at 300,732,065 in table 41. This indicates a comparative-period leak into the current-quarter leaf population, not source rows genuinely lacking fair value.
